purpose: PROPOSALS ONLY. Nothing here is applied to the catalog. Each needs a human decision.

proposals.label: Mineral Bottom Boat Ramp

proposed.source: NPS Public POIs (Canyonlands) 'Mineral Bottom' point, research/raw/gis/nps_CANY.json

proposals.why: Imagery (research/raw/imagery/mineral_bottom_boat_ramp.png): the NPS point is at the launch beside the water, while the BLM point is on the access road 60-70 m south. The NPS is not the managing agency (the site is BLM), so a human must decide whether an NPS coordinate is acceptable.

proposals.label: Cisco Takeout
proposals.applied: coordinate taken from the BLM Cisco Takeout page (managing agency) instead of BLM GIS 67918
proposals.why: Imagery: the GIS point is on the access loop about 150 m from the river; the BLM page coordinate is at the head of the concrete ramp. Both are BLM. Recorded here for review even though it is already in the data.

proposals.label: San Rafael Swinging Bridge Take-out
proposals.why: Three BLM coordinates disagree: GIS 71217 in the campground loop, the Swinging Bridge POI at the north end of the bridge, and the trailhead page about 1.6 km away. A human should mark the real take-out on imagery (research/raw/imagery/san_rafael_swinging_bridge_take_out_z17.png).

proposals.label: Potash Boat Ramp
proposals.why: The NPS POI is in the river. The ramp seen on imagery is about 110 m south (research/raw/imagery/potash_boat_ramp.png). There is no agency coordinate for the ramp itself.
